parameters.query:
WITH attempted AS (
  INSERT INTO events (
    event_id, tenant_id, correlation_id, run_id, idempotency_key, source, purpose,
    data_classification, status, payload_ref, input_hash, release_id, received_at
  )
  VALUES (
    $1::uuid, $2, $3::uuid, $4::uuid, $5, $6, $7,
    $8, 'PROCESSING', $9, $10, $11, $12::timestamptz
  )
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING event_id, status, created_at
),
resolved AS (
  SELECT event_id, status, created_at, true AS is_new FROM attempted
  UNION ALL
  SELECT e.event_id, e.status, e.created_at, false AS is_new
  FROM events e
  WHERE e.idempotency_key = $5
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attempted)
  LIMIT 1
),
artifacts AS (
  INSERT INTO event_artifacts (
    artifact_id, event_id, tenant_id, file_name, mime_type, size_bytes,
    content_hash, content_trust, source_ref, received_at
  )
  SELECT
    md5(r.event_id::text || '|' || (f.value->>'sha256'))::uuid,
    r.event_id, $2,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.value->>'file_name', ''), 'unnamed'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.value->>'mime_type', ''), 'application/octet-stream'),
    COALESCE((f.value->>'size_bytes')::bigint, 0),
    'sha256:' || (f.value->>'sha256'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(f.value->>'content_trust', ''), 'UNTRUSTED'),
    $9, $12::timestamptz
  FROM resolved r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements($13::jsonb) AS f(value)
  WHERE r.is_new AND NULLIF(f.value->>'sha256', '') IS NOT NULL
  ON CONFLICT (event_id, content_hash) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING artifact_id
),
audit_entry AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_log (
    tenant_id, correlation_id, actor, actor_role, action, object_type,
    object_id, outcome, release_id, event_hash, previous_event_hash
  )
  SELECT
    $2, $3::uuid, 'n8n:wf-02', 'PERSISTENCE',
    CASE WHEN r.is_new THEN 'EVENT_REGISTERED' ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END,
    'EVENT', r.event_id::text,
    CASE WHEN r.is_new THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END,
    $11, $15, NULL
  FROM resolved r
  RETURNING audit_id
)
SELECT
  r.event_id,
  r.status AS technical_status,
  r.created_at AS registered_at,
  r.is_new,
  CASE WHEN r.is_new THEN 'PROCESSING' ELSE 'DUPLICATE_IGNORED' END AS registration_status,
  (SELECT count(*)::int FROM artifacts) AS artifacts_registered,
  (SELECT audit_id FROM audit_entry LIMIT 1) AS audit_id,
  $14::jsonb AS envelope
FROM resolved r;
